name: Vehicle Rental System
author: SCUMSA
description: Players rent vehicles straight from in-game chat — /rent, /myrent, /extend, /return — or from a Discord menu if you run a bot. Pick a vehicle, choose a duration, pay in-game money or gold, and the vehicle is spawned next to them and the whole rental lifecycle managed (in-game and Discord notifications, reminders, extensions, early return, auto-removal). Vehicles and plans can be limited to time windows, so a happy hour or a weekend-only price is a setting rather than a job for somebody. Discord is optional; nothing here needs it.

needs.why: Prices a rental against the balance the running game holds this second. With these off the check reads the last server save, so a player can spend their money elsewhere and still rent a vehicle on credit.
